about_the_game:
🎮 Game Overview

Elf Clash is a thrilling real-time strategy battler where strategic cardplay leads to victory. Combine cards, unleash skills, and outsmart your opponents in a dynamic battlefield where every decision counts. The unique projectile collision system ensures no two battles are ever the same, adding layers of unexpected depth and excitement to each encounter.

✨ Key Features

∙Dynamic Projectile Physics: Watch as spells and attacks collide mid-air, altering their trajectories in real-time. Adapt your tactics on the fly—victory favors the quick-witted, not just the strong.

∙Endless Strategic Combinations: Master a diverse arsenal of skills, from defensive setups like Light Barrier, Cyclone, and Time Stop to aggressive tactics such as Multi-Shot and Elemental Magic. Design your own unique playstyle.

∙Build Your Dream Team: Recruit powerful heroes, each with unique abilities. Discover synergistic team compositions and unlock powerful combo effects through clever hero pairing.

∙Escalating Intensity: As you progress and your heroes level up, battles grow more intense—projectiles multiply, collisions intensify, and the action reaches explosive new heights.

🏆 Demo Version Content

Jump into the action-packed Demo, already packed with content:

∙25 Challenging Stages across 7 distinct environments.

∙10+ Playable Heroes, each with unique skills and 3-tier skin evolution paths.

∙20+ Skill Cards to experiment with, spanning Attack, Defense, Magic, and Healing roles.

🗺️ Development Roadmap

∙Version 1.0 (2025): 20 heroes, 50 skill cards, and ~105 stages.

∙Free Update (Early 2026): Additional heroes, cards, stages, and more content.

∙Free Update (Late 2026): Online PvP mode—challenge players worldwide.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11.5 (Big Sur)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / Apple M1
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated (e.g., Intel Iris)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 15.2 (Sonoma) or newer
  • Processor: Apple M1 Pro/Max / Intel i7
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated (e.g., AMD Radeon Pro)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Lead your team to delve into the Three Realms, rescue the abducted detective, retrieve the Energy Spirit Stone, and punish the nefarious forces hiding in the shadows. Each realm presents unique challenges and secrets, and your decisions will sway the course of the battle.
supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil
